page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8ine.8xlarge is a compute-optimized instance from the Enhanced family, hosted on the KVM hypervisor. The system is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon Sapphire Rapids processor offering 32 dedicated vCPUs clocked at 2.7 GHz. System memory totals 64.0 GB, resulting in an allocation ratio of 2.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

Hardware acceleration features omit dedicated GPUs, and the server includes no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage volumes for operational storage requirements. The instance is provisioned with 44 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses by default.

The 1:2 processor-to-memory configuration delivers high CPU density relative to RAM, favoring tasks that do not depend on expansive in-memory caching. This architecture aligns with workloads such as distributed batch computing, CI/CD compilation pipelines, video transcoding, and high-throughput network services.
